restrictions.condition: HanlinArchivePolicy.normalizedRelativePath fails or isContained fails due to trailing slash / private/var symlink aliasing
restrictions.effect: Throws extractionEscapedRoot error, aborting valid Skill ZIP import
restrictions.reason: False escape error caused by Foundation /var vs /private/var normalization and trailing slash differences in staging URL
restrictions.replacementBehavior: Use standardizedFileURL and robust canonical relative path containment resolution matching HanlinPackageCenter

restrictions.condition: File extension is not in hardcoded set (e.g. .xlsx, .docx, .wasm, .bin, .ttf, or LICENSE)
restrictions.effect: Throws unsupportedFileType error, rejecting skill packs containing documentation, assets or data
restrictions.reason: Skills are bundles of instructions and assets, not executable binaries; asset files must not be rejected
restrictions.replacementBehavior: Remove extension allowlist from Skill import policy; allow all valid archive entries that resolve inside target directory

restrictions.condition: Archive exceeds 25MB, 1024 files, 256 directories, depth 16, expanded 64MB, or ratio 100
restrictions.reason: Hardcoded low limits block legitimate rich skill packs and data archives
restrictions.replacementBehavior: Relax limits with streaming extraction and user cancellation rather than arbitrary hard cutoff

restrictions.condition: JSONDecoder() default date decoding encounters ISO-8601 strings in hanlin.json
restrictions.effect: Silent decode failure causing preferredToolIDs and triggerHints to be overwritten with empty arrays
restrictions.reason: Naive JSONDecoder expects Double timestamp; hanlin.json uses ISO-8601 strings
restrictions.replacementBehavior: Implement flexible date decoding supporting ISO-8601 (with fractional seconds), Foundation epoch numbers, and optional dates

restrictions.condition: Total schema bytes for exposed tools exceeds 4KB
restrictions.effect: Hard cap truncates preferredToolIDs schema exposure to model
restrictions.reason: When a skill is explicitly loaded, all its available preferred tools should be exposed without an artificial 4KB clamp
restrictions.replacementBehavior: Expose all valid active tools for loaded skill; paginate discovery if provider token limits require it

restrictions.condition: Source code or comments match regex: child_process, cluster, docker, sudo, curl | sh
restrictions.effect: Throws 'This script requests an unavailable process API' error before execution
restrictions.reason: String scanners falsely reject benign code, comments, documentation, and valid imports
restrictions.replacementBehavior: Remove rejectUnsafeSource; let runtime execute code and report platformUnsupported if an unavailable system syscall is invoked

restrictions.condition: Manifest inspection or compatibility findings contain 'unsupported' severity (binding.gyp, child_process, optional native deps)
restrictions.reason: Blocks installation of valid packages that have unused native files, optional dependencies, or comments
restrictions.replacementBehavior: Convert compatibility inspection into informational diagnostics rather than a blocking veto

restrictions.condition: Command is not in exact 23-command list or extraCommandsDictionary is not empty
restrictions.effect: Throws command_not_registered or 'The command is not linked or allowed'
restrictions.reason: Artificially restricts ios_system to 23 commands and bans extra dictionary registrations
restrictions.replacementBehavior: Query actual registered and executable commands dynamically from ios_system dictionary

restrictions.condition: Command uses shell syntax (pipes, redirection, chaining) or curl uses HTTP or allow_network is false
restrictions.effect: Rejects command or throws capability error
restrictions.reason: Structured argv and raw command syntax are distinct; curl should work over HTTP/LAN without internal approval gate
restrictions.replacementBehavior: Support program+arguments (argv mode) and command string (ios_system parser mode) with real capabilities

restrictions.condition: Wheel size > 100MB, dependencies > 64, wheel contains .pth/.wasm, or wheel is not py3-none-any
restrictions.reason: Blocks pure Python wheels with assets (.wasm/.pth data) and projects with deep dependency trees
restrictions.replacementBehavior: Support ABI/platform matching, streaming extraction, cancellation, and sdist build fallback

restrictions.effect: Throws 'Execution workspace is outside RuntimeCore clients'
restrictions.reason: Prevents unified agent context where Python, Node, and shell work in the same shared workspace directory
restrictions.replacementBehavior: Allow any valid path accessible to the app process sandbox / user selected security-scoped bookmark

restrictions.condition: Filename contains '..' as a substring (e.g. release..notes.md)
restrictions.effect: Rejects resource read with path traversal error
restrictions.reason: String contains('..') confuses benign filenames containing double dots with directory traversal
restrictions.replacementBehavior: Use path component decomposition and standardized URL containment checks instead of substring matching

restrictions.condition: Legacy request pipeline handles model tool calls via custom recursion loop
restrictions.effect: Creates a parallel unmaintained tool execution path competing with Swift AI SDK
restrictions.reason: Swift AI SDK engine (HanlinAISDKAgentEngine) must be the single authoritative agent loop
restrictions.replacementBehavior: Consolidate remote agent/tool execution onto HanlinAISDKAgentEngine; remove legacy APIManager tool recursion
